::: {.fun .plum}
If any of our projects sound interesting to you, or maybe you need help with anything involving proteins - such as recombinant protein expression or assay development - do not hesitate to reach out. We are always eager to work with similarly passionate folks!
:::

    <h3>Interested in Joining?</h3>
    
    <p style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
      Our lab is affiliated with the <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/colleges/science-mathematics/departments/biochemistry-chemistry-physics" target="_blank">Department of Biochemistry, Chemistry, and Physics</a>, and the <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/colleges/science-mathematics/departments/biomedical-sciences" target="_blank">Department of Biomedical Sciences</a>, and welcome students from our programs to explore research options! 
    </p>

    <p style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
      That said, if you are highly passionate about science and research and interested in any of the work we do, or adjacent areas, chat with us to see if there is any opportunity to work together. Any majors at Georgia Southern are welcome to join at various capacities. Majority of the students in the lab are <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/degrees/bachelor-of-science-in-biomedical-sciences" target="_blank">Biomedical Sciences</a>, <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/degrees/bs-biochemistry" target="_blank">Biochemistry</a>, and <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/degrees/bs-chemistry" target="_blank">Chemistry</a> majors, but we do not require any prior training or classes. Students can get research credit (BIO, BMED, BCHM, CHEM, or VIP) and/or may be employed as student researchers, depending on funding situation. Summer fellowships are sometimes available from the department or the college.
    </p>
    
    <p style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
      We do not typically advertise positions for MS students, as we mostly host students in the accelerated <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/degrees/masters-in-applied-physical-science" target="_blank">BS-MS Applied Physical Science program</a>. We anticipate trainees from our recently launched <a href="https://www.georgiasouthern.edu/degrees/phd-in-biomedical-sciences" target="_blank">PhD in Biomedical Sciences Program</a>. Post-doctoral and staff positions are dependent on funding. Reach out directly if you need a sponsor for a grant or a fellowship. High school and external students may also participate either virtually for computational work or during the summer through research opportunities or transient/dual-enrollment.
    </p>
